entities.name: Regīna Ezera
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Regīna Ezera, the pen name of Regīna Šamreto, was a Latvian author of Polish origin who wrote more than 20 novels. A recipient of the Order of the Three Stars, she suffered financially as a result of the end of communism, living in some poverty at the end of her life.
